prompt: Create a photorealistic editorial travel photograph using the attached female character reference as the exact identity reference. Preserve her facial identity, facial proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, and recognizable features. Do not alter her identity or make her look like a different person. A sophisticated European summer portrait of the woman standing beside an old stone balustrade directly on the waterfront of Lake Como, Italy. She is positioned in the lower-center/left portion of the composition, leaning casually against the weathered stone railing with both hands resting naturally on the top surface. Her body is angled slightly toward the camera while her head and gaze turn toward the lake, creating a candid, contemplative side-profile moment. She has dark brown/black hair loosely tied into a relaxed low messy bun, with a few natural strands falling around her face. She wears subtle dark sunglasses with a refined vintage shape. Outfit: loose oversized white linen button-down shirt, slightly sheer natural linen texture, casually unbuttoned at the collar, sleeves loosely rolled to approximately the forearms, relaxed untucked silhouette. Pair it with high-waisted, extremely wide-leg dark navy/charcoal trousers, soft flowing fabric, relaxed European tailoring. She wears simple white low-top retro sneakers with slightly chunky soles. A natural woven/canvas shoulder tote hangs from her left shoulder, visible along the side of her body. Her pose should feel completely candid and unposed, like a sophisticated travel photograph captured spontaneously rather than a fashion-model pose. One hand rests farther along the stone railing and the other hangs naturally near the edge of the railing. Relaxed posture, slightly bent elbows, natural weight distribution. Background: unmistakable Lake Como, calm deep blue-green water extending behind her, magnificent steep Italian Alps rising dramatically across the lake. The mountain should dominate the upper-left background with visible gray limestone rock faces, dense green vegetation and subtle atmospheric haze. Across the lake are elegant traditional Italian villas and waterfront houses with warm cream, pale yellow and terracotta facades, red clay tile roofs, balconies, shutters, manicured gardens and tall narrow Italian cypress trees. Include a single white swan floating on the water in the middle-right background, slightly behind the woman. The swan should be clearly recognizable but not become the focal point. Architecture should feel authentically northern Italian and luxurious but understated. Weathered historic stone railing in the foreground with decorative cut-out/clover-shaped openings, aged gray limestone texture, slightly worn surfaces. Composition: vertical portrait photograph, approximately 9:16, full-body framing from the top of her head to her shoes, with enough surrounding environment to establish Lake Como. Camera approximately at chest/eye heig

promptZh: 使用所附的女性角色参考图作为身份基准，创作一张照片级的旅拍风格人像。请务必保留她的面部特征、面部比例、肤色、发型及其他可辨识的细节。请勿改变其身份或将其处理成其他人。画面主体为一位 女性，她站在 意大利科莫湖 湖畔的一处古老石质栏杆旁，拍摄一张精致的欧洲夏季人像。她位于构图的左下方，身体随意地倚靠在饱经风霜的石栏杆上，双手自然地搭在栏杆顶部。她的身体略微侧向镜头，头部和视线转向湖面，营造出一种不经意的、沉思般的侧颜瞬间。她留着深棕色/黑色头发，随意地扎成一个松散的低发髻，几缕发丝自然地垂落在脸颊旁。她戴着一副精致的复古风深色墨镜。服装：宽松的白色亚麻衬衫，带有天然亚麻的微透质感，领口随意解开，袖子松散地卷至前臂处，呈现出随性的未束腰廓形。搭配高腰、极宽腿的深海军蓝/炭灰色长裤，面料柔软垂坠，展现出轻松的欧式剪裁。她穿着简单的白色复古低帮运动鞋，鞋底略厚。一个天然编织/帆布材质的单肩包挂在她的左肩，在身体侧面可见。她的姿势应显得完全自然、不做作，就像一张随手抓拍的精致旅拍照片，而非模特摆拍。一只手搭在石栏杆较远的位置，另一只手自然地垂在栏杆边缘附近。姿态放松，肘部微屈，重心分布自然。背景：标志性的科莫湖，平静的深蓝绿色湖水在她身后延伸，壮丽的意大利阿尔卑斯山在湖对岸巍然耸立。山脉应占据左上方的背景，清晰可见灰色的石灰岩岩壁、茂密的绿色植被以及微妙的大气雾感。湖对岸是优雅的传统意大利别墅和滨水住宅，外墙呈奶油色、淡黄色和赤陶色，配有红瓦屋顶、阳台、百叶窗、修剪整齐的花园以及高耸狭长的意大利柏树。在右中方的背景处，即女性身后稍远一点的位置，加入一只漂浮在水面上的白天鹅。天鹅应清晰可辨，但不要成为视觉焦点。建筑应呈现出地道的北意大利风格，奢华而低调。前景是饱经风霜的历史感石栏杆，带有装饰性的镂空/三叶草形开口，呈现出陈旧的灰色石灰岩质感，表面略有磨损。构图：竖构图人像，比例约为 9:16，从头顶到鞋子的全身取景，并保留足够的周围环境以展现科莫湖的氛围。相机高度约为胸部/眼部水平。
